IconKeys.note: All 13 SessionControlIconKey values in a labelled swatch grid — every glyph is distinct and correctly sized by icon-paired.

ComposerControlRow.note: The glyphs back in their product home: model / mode / branch / auto-approve pills on a composer-background bar, with the success tone on the shield.

HandoffModeOptions.note: Popover-surface option list (the plan-handoff mode picker shape) with the icon in the leading slot and two-line labels.

UnknownFallback.note: null and undefined both fall back to the outlined question glyph instead of collapsing the leading slot.
